name: The Newest Member of the Family

meta.wiki: The Newest Member of the Family

summary: Only an hour remains to bring the fragile egg to Agnar Beastamer at Aerie Peak, before the hatchling inside dies.

sections.title: Hurry to Aerie Peak
sections.body: Quentin calls the sprite darter egg a magnificent specimen. If it survives, it will make a healthy pet. He sends you to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands, where Agnar Beastamer can guide the final steps of incubation. The dwarf is a master animal handler, and the egg cannot go long without care. Find Agnar within an hour, or the hatchling inside will die. He lives in Wildhammer Keep.

sections.title: Agnar's Verdict
sections.body: Agnar Beastamer has not seen such a creature in ages. He names it a faerie dragon of the sprite darter kind. The little one needs food to hatch and grow strong. Agnar is glad you arrived in time.

faq.q: Who sends you to Agnar Beastamer?
aliases: who starts the newest member of the family
faq.answer: Quentin sends you to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands with the fragile egg after A Short Incubation.

aliases: where do I take the egg
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer, a dwarf and master animal handler, must receive the egg at Aerie Peak. He lives in Wildhammer Keep.

faq.q: How much time is there to deliver the egg?
faq.answer: One hour. If you do not bring the egg to Agnar in that time, the hatchling inside dies.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows A Short Incubation and sends you with the egg to Agnar Beastamer at Aerie Peak.
